test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven boys Ram, Sumit, Sunil, Rahul, Raj, Aman and Amit are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Raj is second to the right of Aman. Sunil is third to the left of Aman. Ram is not the immediate neighbour of Aman. Amit is second to the right of Ram. Rahul is not the immediate neighbour of Amit, Who is third to the left of Sumit?
solution:
Given: Seven boys Ram, Sumit, Sunil, Rahul, Raj, Aman and Amit.

1) Raj is second to the right of Aman.

2) Sunil is third to the left of Aman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daa1d17ef76bdb060d3c9630891191ae36fcec800c720fb35d0d6ebd8f1575fe.png] 

3) Ram is not the immediate neighbour of Aman.
